meaning.long_meaning: Babul corresponds to the Hindi form बब्बूल. Its core lexical sense is the babul tree (vachellia nilotica). बबूल (babul) is the Hindi name of the tree Vachellia nilotica, used as a personal name. The source record asserted no usable gloss.
